run_evaluation_experiment: run an evaluation experiment using a config file via the evaluate entry point
configure_evaluation: configure the evaluation by passing a custom config file path with the --config flag
run_main_with_config: run the main function that loads a config and calls evaluation.run_experiment
validate_cli_arguments: validate that no extra command-line arguments are passed to the evaluate entry point
use_as_entry_point: use evaluate.py as the entry point for running annealed flow transport evaluation algorithms
